issues.detail: The Hebrew 'גֶּרֶשׂ כַּרְמֶל' means 'crushed fresh grain' (or 'groats of fresh grain'), not '迦密山的麥子' (wheat from Mount Carmel). 'כַּרְמֶל' here is a common noun meaning 'fresh/ripe grain', not the proper name Carmel. This changes the meaning from a description of the grain's condition to a geographical location.
